# vappcloud_device (Resource)

A logical VAppCloud device created in pending enrollment state. Compute may later attach to it.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Device name.
- `project_id` (String) Owning project ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `default_vmm_id` (String) System-managed default VMM ID, populated after the agent becomes healthy.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `resource_version` (Number) Optimistic concurrency version.
- `state` (String) Enrollment and connection state.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC3339 format.
